The main takeaway from our work is that
the West Greenland Group I kimberlite source is a metasomatized, ancient subducted ocean crust, which was subsequently incorporated into the mantle.
the Hf-Ndi systematics of kimberlites can be used to identify ancient subduction-modified mantle sources.

the Hf-Ndi systematics of kimberlites provide an independent means of identifying source-forming processes and can be used as a complement to other geochemical and geophysical data in constraining the origin of kimberlite magmatism.
